benchmark.independence_note: The benchmark was authored by the same agent that maintains the instrument. It is a pre-registered held-out-style case set, NOT independent validation. The instrument remains a lexical screening heuristic until a separately authored/sealed benchmark earns structural authority.

classification_basis: owner audit 2026-11-13: a lexical term instrument may screen candidates but cannot establish causal distinctness; the measured rates below are reported, NOT converted into a pass/fail threshold or structural authority

metric_definitions.false_merge_rate: of expected-DISTINCT pairs, the fraction predicted EQUIVALENT (a real mechanism difference merged away)
metric_definitions.false_split_rate_non_equivalent: of expected-EQUIVALENT pairs, the fraction predicted anything other than EQUIVALENT (DISTINCT or INDETERMINATE; the deferral is honest, but it still fails to merge a pair known to be the same family)
metric_definitions.false_split_rate_strict: of expected-EQUIVALENT pairs, the fraction predicted DISTINCT (the same mechanism split into two)
metric_definitions.indeterminate_recall: of expected-INDETERMINATE pairs, the fraction the instrument correctly deferred
